title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE TEN VIRGINS—ARE YOU READY FOR THE RETURN OF JESUS? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE TEN VIRGINS—ARE YOU READY FOR THE RETURN OF JESUS? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, what does the Parable of the Ten Virgins mean? Is it just about a wedding, or is Jesus warning us about something bigger?"

🚨 MANY PEOPLE THINK THEY ARE READY FOR JESUS—BUT ARE THEY REALLY PREPARED? The Parable of the Ten Virgins is one of the most serious warnings Jesus gave about the End Times, and most Christians today are ignoring it!
📖 Key Verse: "Therefore, keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour." (Matthew 25:13)
🔥 ARE YOU A WISE VIRGIN OR A FOOLISH ONE? 🔥

🔥 1. THE PARABLE OF THE TEN VIRGINS (MATTHEW 25:1-13)
📖 "At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom. Five of them were foolish, and five were wise. The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them. The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps. The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep. At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here’s the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’"
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS PARABLE MEAN?

✔️ The Virgins = Those who claim to follow Jesus.
✔️ The Bridegroom = Jesus Christ.
✔️ The Wedding Feast = The Kingdom of Heaven.
✔️ The Oil = The Holy Spirit & true faith.
✔️ The Closed Door = Judgment—too late to enter!
🔥 THIS IS A WARNING: MANY WILL BE LEFT OUTSIDE WHEN JESUS RETURNS!

🔥 2. WHY WERE THE FIVE VIRGINS CALLED FOOLISH?
📖 Matthew 25:3 – "The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them."
💡 THEY LOOKED READY, BUT THEY WEREN’T PREPARED!

❌ They had lamps but no oil – They had religion, but not the Holy Spirit.
❌ They waited but were not prepared – They thought they had time to fix things later.
❌ They asked for oil at the last minute – You cannot borrow someone else’s salvation!
❌ The door was SHUT on them – They were locked out of God’s Kingdom FOREVER.
🚨 HOW MANY "CHRISTIANS" TODAY ARE JUST LIKE THE FOOLISH VIRGINS?

✔️ They go to church but don’t have a real relationship with Jesus.
✔️ They say they believe but live like the world.
✔️ They think they have time to get serious about God "later."
✔️ They don’t read the Bible, don’t pray, don’t evangelize.
🔥 DO NOT WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE! THE DOOR WILL BE SHUT! 🔥

🔥 3. WHAT MADE THE WISE VIRGINS DIFFERENT?
📖 Matthew 25:4 – "The wise ones took oil in jars along with their lamps."
💡 THEY WERE PREPARED—THEY LIVED EVERY DAY READY FOR JESUS!

✔️ THEY HAD OIL – They were filled with the Holy Spirit and walked in obedience.
✔️ THEY KEPT THEIR LAMPS BURNING – They stayed faithful, prayerful, and watchful.
✔️ THEY DIDN’T RELY ON OTHERS’ FAITH – They had a personal relationship with Jesus.
✔️ THEY WERE ALERT AND READY – They knew Jesus could return at any moment!
🚨 IF JESUS CAME BACK TONIGHT, WOULD YOU BE A WISE OR A FOOLISH VIRGIN?

🔥 4. THE DOOR WILL BE SHUT—NO SECOND CHANCES!
📖 Matthew 25:10 – "And the door was shut."
💡 WHEN JESUS RETURNS, THERE WILL BE NO LAST-MINUTE EXCUSES!

❌ The foolish virgins begged, "Lord, Lord, open the door!"
❌ Jesus answered, "Truly, I tell you, I do not know you!" (Matthew 25:12)
🚨 THIS IS A TERRIFYING WARNING! Many people think they are saved, but they will hear Jesus say, "I NEVER KNEW YOU!" (Matthew 7:21-23)
🔥 DO NOT GAMBLE WITH YOUR ETERNITY! BE READY EVERY DAY! 🔥

🔥 5. HOW TO BE A WISE VIRGIN—HOW TO PREPARE FOR JESUS’ RETURN!
📖 Revelation 16:15 – "Behold, I come like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps his garments on, so that he may not go about naked and be seen exposed!"
💡 THE TIME IS NOW—THIS IS HOW TO BE READY!

✔️ SURRENDER TO JESUS – Make Him Lord over every part of your life! (Romans 10:9)
✔️ BE FILLED WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT – You need His power to endure! (Acts 1:8)
✔️ LIVE IN HOLINESS – No more compromise with sin! (1 Peter 1:16)
✔️ READ & OBEY THE BIBLE DAILY – God’s Word must guide your life! (Psalm 119:105)
✔️ EVANGELIZE & MAKE DISCIPLES – Your purpose is to spread the Gospel! (Matthew 28:19-20)
✔️ STAY FAITHFUL UNTIL THE END – Don’t give up, Jesus is coming! (Revelation 3:11)
🚨 DON’T WAIT UNTIL THE LAST MINUTE—THE DOOR WILL BE SHUT!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I WILL NOT BE A FOOLISH VIRGIN! I CHOOSE TO BE READY FOR JESUS EVERY DAY!"

🔥 THE FINAL PREPARATION CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly ready for Jesus?
✅ Step 3: Stay watchful—live each day like it’s your last!
🔥 #WiseOrFoolish #BeReadyForJesus #EndTimesWarning #SpiritualPreparation #FinalJudgment #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis
